## MERGED as Gerrit 1343, and the ticket-sync blocker that held it is resolved.

CI's `require resolvable rebar ticket` gate had been failing this change for a reason that had nothing to do with the change: this ticket existed only in the local store, because GitHub push protection had blocked every `tickets`-branch push for ~8 hours over live credentials in an unrelated ticket's comment ([rebar:94d0-5d19-2d06-4fa7]). With the store synced, the gate resolves `339a-57ac-e5f3-4718` and CI passes on the same code it had already reviewed.

All four ACs met — three unit-proven, one live-proven on run 30874380112 (`test_inbound_clear_parent_round_trips` red -> green).
